Description: On-demand open-source speech model image build; isolated from live TechVerse tutor.

com.aws.cloudformation.Context.why: Store a single versioned private Whisper image
com.aws.cloudformation.Context.must: No public repository; scan images; retain only recent build images

com.aws.cloudformation.Context.why: Allow image build to write only its ECR repository and logs
com.aws.cloudformation.Context.must: No access to tutor secrets, student data or Lambda deployments
No schedule, no secrets, max 15 minute build, offline recognition of synthetic speech before push
